task: 4-class boxing stance classification from MediaPipe Holistic pose landmarks

provenance.note: The .npy filenames carry local (BRT, UTC-3) timestamps; the run start times below come from mlflow.db in UTC. The original runs logged to MLflow under mlruns/, which this monorepo gitignores, so the classification reports and confusion matrices were copied out of those run artifacts, and the MLflow SQLite store plus the three logged model pickles were added under Git LFS in model_artifacts/.

data.collection: self-collected through data_collector.py from a webcam; one person, auto-capture every 5th frame
data.split: train_test_split(test_size=0.2, random_state=42), not stratified; test n=80 with class counts 26/18/18/18

accuracy_derivation: The compare_models runs committed only their confusion matrix artifact, so their accuracies were first read off the annotated matrices as diagonal/80. Opening model_artifacts/mlflow.db afterwards confirmed all five values independently (0.95, 0.975, 0.975, 0.9875, 0.975), so the numbers now have two agreeing sources plus the reproduction run.

shipped_model.file: pose_classifier_model.pkl at the experiment root (gitignored; regenerate by training)
shipped_model.how: sha256 565adb632dac51714341b4fe18e657b69ec5386caff5888cb2fffaba62919908, byte-identical to mlruns model m-193baba3c9db46f39776055a188dfc88, and the pickle stream names XGBClassifier/xgboost.sklearn; that model's logged requirements list xgboost==2.1.4 while the other two logged models do not

recorded_environment.source: MLmodel + logged requirements.txt of m-193baba3c9db46f39776055a188dfc88 (see logged_model_env_record.txt)

reproduction_2026_10_15.environment: D:/mlops-experiments/.venv - python 3.11.9, numpy 1.26.4, scikit-learn 1.4.2, xgboost 3.2.0, lightgbm 4.6.0, mlflow 3.11.1
reproduction_2026_10_15.verdict: all five recorded numbers reproduced exactly under a different library stack

caveats: test n=80: one sample is 1.25 pp, so XGBoost (79/80) versus RandomForest and LightGBM (78/80) is a single-sample difference, not evidence of a better model
single split, single seed, no cross-validation and no confidence interval
frames were captured continuously from the same takes, so a frame-level split puts near-duplicate frames on both sides of the split; accuracy is optimistic for a new person, new room or new camera
one collector only, so the four classes are that person's execution of a stance
labels are self-declared at capture time (the key pressed), not verified by a second annotator
